search.name: Honorific Cycle
search.website_text:
Cycle custom Honorific titles. # Honorific Cycle

Honorific Cycle is a Dalamud plugin for rotating custom Honorific titles.

It lets users create multiple titles and cycle through them automatically. Each title can have its own duration and Honorific style.

Supported Honorific options:

- Prefix or suffix
- Title color
- Solid glow
- Preset gradients
- Two-color gradients
- Gradient animation style

Commands:

```text
/honorificcycle
/hcycle
/hcycle add
/hcycle clear
/hcycle apply
```

Honorific must be installed and loaded for the title IPC calls to work.
